name: Call Partner Rook
description: Four-player Rook variant using all 57 cards. Deal 13 each and 5 to the nest; players bid in multiples of 5 (dealer first). High bidder takes the nest, discards five, names trump, and calls a partner by naming a card not in hand; that card's holder is the secret partner (or bidder plays alone if holding it). Twelve tricks; follow color; Rook ranks between 11 and 10 in trump. First to 500 wins.

Call Partner Rook is a four-player Rook variant from the United States. Partner is determined each hand by the bidder naming a card; whoever holds it plays with the bidder for that hand.
Four players; two teams per hand (bidder and called partner vs others).

One card at a time to each player until each has 13; first card goes to the player to dealer's left. After each of the first five rounds of the deal, one card is placed face down in the center to form the five-card nest.
